method.filtering_summary: Live search at about 7:31 AM EAT on 16 sources pulled 2,634 postings. 1,819 were older than 7 days and 50 were old reposts, 298 were senior or excluded titles, 185 were not target roles, 164 were excluded by Kenya eligibility, 8 were already applied and 30 duplicates, leaving 80 kept by the script. Roles already shown in earlier briefings were skipped. Jobgether (507 pulled, 201 from the last 7 days, 21 kept) and micro1 (71 pulled, 28 from the last 7 days, 13 kept) answered live. The new micro1 postings were mostly specialist expert work (electronics, metrology, drilling, semiconductor, SysML), so only the Frontend / UI Engineer fits; the Jobgether engineering offers are tied to European countries. ReliefWeb failed (ParseError). Wellfound’s automated fetch is disabled by design and was checked through the signed-in browser by a separate pass. Jobicy dates look like bump dates (all 50 postings look fresh), so treat its dates with caution. Only 4 roles passed the live check and fit; nothing old was added to fill the list.

stories.title: xAI turns on default text watermarking for Grok API models
stories.summary: As of Nov. 7, SpaceXSI watermarks text by default from Grok 4.7, 4.6, 4.5, 4.3 and the Grok 4.20 models, including structured output and tool-call arguments in the Responses and Chat Completions APIs; look for `x-watermark: true` in response headers. Team admins can turn it off for eligible models in the Console if they confirm a legal exception applies.
stories.why: If he builds on the Grok API, tool-call arguments and structured JSON now carry a watermark header, and admins can switch it off per model.

stories.title: Moonshot publishes Kimi K3.1 Pro weights; Tencent releases DSpine draft weights for Qwen3.8-27B
stories.summary: Kimi K3.1 Pro climbed from 12th to 5th on OpenRouter (up 56.4%) after Moonshot published the weights. Tencent’s DSpine draft model reached 3.84 times ordinary autoregressive decoding throughput in its eight-request concurrent Office replay test, under Apache 2.0.
stories.why: Open-weight models are closing the gap, which helps anyone doing self-hosted inference or quantization like his capstone work.

stories.title: Anthropic still targeting a pre-Thanksgiving US IPO
stories.summary: Targeting an $80 billion to $100 billion raise at a valuation of $1.25 trillion to $1.75 trillion; Q3 revenue rose nearly 50% to about $17 billion and the annualized run rate is about $81 billion. JPMorgan is expected to hold an investor briefing on Friday, Nov. 13.
stories.why: A listing of that size would shape AI hiring and compute spending across the industry.

stories.title: DayOne files for US IPO while Groq seeks $8 billion valuation
stories.summary: Singapore-based DayOne Data Centers submitted paperwork for a US IPO and is weighing a raise of about $5 billion. Nvidia-backed Groq is in talks on a Series B at an $8 billion valuation, more than double its August value.
stories.why: AI inference and data-centre capital keeps flowing, which supports demand for engineers who can build on top of it.

stories.title: Fal raises $1.65B and Salesforce agrees to buy Cresta for $2.7B
stories.summary: Fal raised a combined $1.65 billion across Series E and F (the $1.3 billion F led by Bessemer Venture Partners), doubling its value since April to $16 billion. Salesforce agreed to acquire Cresta, a voice-first customer-experience platform, for $2.7B.
stories.why: Agentic and generative-media companies are raising large rounds, a sign of where AI engineering jobs are opening.

stories.title: 936 new internship and new-grad software roles listed in the week of Nov 2 to 8
stories.summary: SWE Job Lists first listed 936 internship and new-grad software roles (580 internships, 356 new grad) from 361 companies, down 21% on the week before; 4% were remote and 28% of those with an H-1B label were labelled yes or likely.
stories.why: Entry-level supply is thin and mostly on-site in the US, so remote roles open to Kenya are worth applying to quickly.

stories.title: Dreamwork index: 870,882 tech roles, 7.4% flagged as AI
stories.summary: As of Nov. 8, Dreamwork’s index lists 870,882 eligible roles at 48,486 employers, with 64,532 flagged as AI roles; 3,981 employers (8.2%) have both a remote and an entry-level role open.
stories.why: Only a small share of employers combine remote and entry-level openings, which matches how few roles fit him each day.

stories.title: Kenya’s digital lenders face rules on AI credit decisions
stories.summary: Regulation 60 of the CBK Non-Deposit Taking Credit Providers Regulations, 2026 (Legal Notice No. 191, gazetted Sept 29) requires providers to explain automated decisions, disclose AI interactions and keep human oversight; CBK had licensed 281 digital credit providers by September 2026.
stories.why: Kenyan fintechs using AI for credit scoring now need explainability and human review, which is relevant to loan-automation work like his.

stories.title: Nigeria’s Redtech plans a Kenya-Nigeria payments corridor
stories.summary: Redtech’s CEO says its first Kenyan product launches by Q1 2027 at the latest, starting with payment and collection tools for micro, small and medium businesses; it has not named Kenyan partners or disclosed its CBK licensing status.
stories.why: A new cross-border payments entrant could mean API and integration roles in Nairobi from 2027.

stories.title: TechCabal: Kenyan banks keep posting record profits as Fuliza grows
stories.summary: Combined pre-tax profits of Kenya’s largest lenders rose 17.6% to KES 305.95 billion in 2025; Fuliza revenue rose 86% to KES 4.9 billion in the six months to September 2026, with 17.2 million borrowers and an average advance down 24.6% to KES 192.
stories.why: Lending through M-PESA is where the growth is, which is the space his loan-simulation work sits in.
